items.text: Lamar Jackson: “Right now, I'm headed in the right direction.” Dealing with high ankle sprain; practice encouraging vs Bengals.
items.why: High ankle sprain but positive self-report and promising practice movement/throws.
items.implication: Likely active Sunday; full QB1 if cleared, monitor final designation.
items.opportunity: Returning starter role intact if plays.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle/high-ankle sprain) ruled out by coach Mike LaFleur; will miss another game this week.
items.why: Still recovering from high-ankle sprain; coach confirmation.
items.implication: Another missed game; handcuff/backup elevated in ARI backfield.
items.opportunity: Full workload shift to remaining RBs.

items.text: Colts HC Shane Steichen ruled out TE Tyler Warren (groin) and CB Sauce Gardner (calf) for Sunday vs Vikings.
items.implication: TE targets redistribute in IND; check Downs/Pittman/others for bump.

items.text: Puka Nacua calf injury believed minor after tests, but status “up in the air” for Sunday vs Raiders; left practice limited.
items.why: Exited Thursday practice with calf; tests show minor but availability uncertain late-week.
items.implication: GTD; if OUT, heavy TE target share historically and Adams already IR.
items.opportunity: If out: elevated TE (Higbee/Parkinson) and remaining WR snaps; if in: full volume.

items.text: Bucs HC Todd Bowles: Baker Mayfield “looks like he’s ready to go” and is now expected to start Sunday vs Panthers.
items.why: Coach confirmation after full practice/looks ready.
items.implication: Stabilizes TB offense; positive for pass-catchers like Godwin/Evans/Irving.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson has played on just 21% of the snaps over the last three weeks. Not like this.
items.why: Persistently low snap share last three weeks despite prior hype.
items.implication: Limited fantasy upside until role expands; Rhamondre Stevenson preferred in NE backfield.
items.opportunity: Low snaps/carries; monitor for any change but currently buried.

items.text: Luther Burden has only run 68.8% of the routes this season but elite 2.56 YPRR. Kmet injury may reduce 2- and 3-sets, giving Burden even more juice.
items.why: Elite YPRR on limited routes; Kmet IR likely expands single-TE/personnel packages favoring Burden.
items.implication: Immediate target/route share bump for Burden in CHI passing game.
items.opportunity: Higher route % and targets with Kmet out long-term.

items.text: Saquon Barkley is “in line” to play vs Dallas Monday (RB15 rank); efficient in full games played; Dallas strong RB matchup.
items.why: Returned to limited practice; reports confirm in line after hamstring.
items.implication: RB2/flex floor with upside in good matchup; monitors final status.
items.opportunity: Reclaims lead back role; passing-game involvement possible.

items.text: The more I watch Jaylen Warren, the more I love his game. Steelers have something special. Loves him @ NO (RB9).
items.why: Workload + friendly matchup vs defense carved by RBs; consistent volume.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): back in real role, Bears good for yardage; 33% target share, 97% routes despite drops in prior.
items.why: Elite route/target share; matchup vs Bears secondary favorable for yardage.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18): workload questions after long layoff.
items.why: Layoff + tough Lions front; role uncertainty.
items.implication: Fade/sit if better options; monitor snaps.
items.conflict: Levitan notes facility access and poor backup EPA may support return.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (WR32): nasty matchup.
